plain: Strict belief in the accepted teachings of a faith.

webster.text: Soundness of faith; a belief in the genuine doctrines taught in the Scriptures.

example.quote: and none have been more frequently successful in the attempt, than those who have covered their ambitious designs under the garb of a fiery zeal for religious orthodoxy.
example.cite: An Old Whig V, Philadelphia Independent Gazetteer, Nov. 1, 1787
